items.title: Jimmy Wormworth interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 6, 2002
items.q: The transcript identifies Monk Rowe as the interviewer conducting the session with Jimmy Wormworth. No personal or professional relationship beyond the interview context is described.

ctx.x: Jimmy was interviewed in New York City on January 6, 2002 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
My name is Monk Rowe and we are in Manhattan filming for the Hamilton College Jazz Archive. I’ve very pleased to have Jimmy Wormworth with me here. Welcome.
I’m very pleased to be here. Thank you.
